prompts.object: Editorial still life photograph of a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, photographed as a physical object on a plain pale surface, soft north-window light with long gentle shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Overhead still life of one short straight row of five thin matte six-sided hexagon tiles in blue and white on a pale surface, each tile separate with open space around it, even spacing, the row filling only the middle half of the frame width. Subject centred with a quiet margin around it. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: one small separate six-sided hexagon tile in amber glass resting on top of the last tile in the row. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
